description: Outcome eval (issue #153): twelve multi-hop tasks over Django 5.1.4 (the django/ package) - transitive callers three levels up, blast radius over 16 to 24 files, and callers of one of several same-named functions. Gold sets were computed by evals/agent/groundtruth/outcome_tasks.py from the call graph of py_edges.py (Python's ast module, import-aware, function-local and star imports included), never from myceliums output, and audited by grepping every name on each chain. Each gold item lists one evidence line (a call site on the chain) that check-tasks re-verifies; its note gives the level and the next hop.

tasks.question: Which functions or methods in the `django/` package call `get_permission_codename` (django/contrib/auth/__init__.py) directly, call such a caller, or call one of those - that is, every caller up to three levels up the call chain? Consider only the `django/` package (not `tests/`, `docs/` or other top-level directories). Count direct calls by name: imported names and re-exports count (also imports inside a function body and `module.function(...)` after `from django.utils import formats`), and so do calls through `self`, `cls` or `super()`, which count for the method the enclosing class defines or inherits from its base classes (not for overrides in subclasses), and class instantiation by the class's name, which counts as a call of the `__init__` the class defines or inherits. A call inside a nested function, lambda or decorator wrapper counts for the outermost enclosing function or method. Calls on other objects' attributes (for example `model_admin.get_queryset(request)`, `self.storage.path(name)`, `request.user.has_perm(...)`), instantiation through a variable (`redirect_class(url)`) and passing a function as a value (decorators applied with `@`, callbacks) do not count. Ignore docstrings and comments. Do not list `get_permission_codename` itself.
tasks.rationale: Admin permission checks: level 1 is the four `has_*_permission` methods of `BaseModelAdmin`, `InlineModelAdmin._has_any_perms_for_target_model` and the permission builder of contrib/auth/management; the levels above run through `self.has_*_permission(...)` in ModelAdmin, InlineModelAdmin and UserAdmin views. Computed as all callers up to 3 levels up the py_edges.py --local-imports --star-imports (import-aware AST, `direct` edges) call graph; 36 functions. Each note gives the level, the function called on the way to the target and the caller's module.
verified_with: grep audit of every name on each chain (outcome_tasks.py --audit)
